title: generate-azure-finops-review parameters
description: All parameters are optional. The monthly scheduled task calls {"operation": "report"}. Scope (subscriptions or management group), cost metric, allocation tags and thresholds are set in the CONFIGURE block of the tool code, never by the agent.

operation.description: report writes four files (offline HTML report, JSON snapshot, findings CSV, cost-by-resource CSV) and returns links, verdict, headline, KPIs, top actions and coverage. query returns one bounded chat view (no files). self_test writes the complete report from built-in SIMULATED data with no network and no configuration.

limit.description: Maximum rows for operation=query; the answer is also capped to 3,500 bytes (transport_capped=true when rows were dropped).
